dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: I'm the longest living resident here... One of them anyway. Perhaps only Keon, who's a few years my elder, can compete with me.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: It was a blessing in disguise, this carefree life in the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: I was a researcher of the Akademiya in my youth, but I was caught up in vicious academic competition.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Hmph! I didn't want to fight with those unethical researchers. A secluded life in the forest was way better.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: It was at here where I realized that knowledge, power, and wealth are the source of our troubles, and that a simple life is the best life.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Those youngsters from the Akademiya should learn the Forest Rangers' way of life!
